The Pantone color that’s officially named “Sky Blue” is **Pantone 14‑4318**.  
(If you’re looking for a slightly different hue, Pantone offers several “sky” variants—e.g., 15‑4510 “Light Sky Blue” or 16‑4527 “Deep Sky Blue”—but 14‑4318 is the classic Pantone designation for Sky Blue.)
